collectible:2.text: Rampages are challenges started via collectibles in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. There are a total of 35 Rampages located all around Vice City, appearing as a rotating white skull pickup item, which the player must find and collect while on foot and not in an active mission to trigger the challenge. If the player fails a Rampage, they are allowed to immediately restart it at its original spawn point.

easter-egg:1.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:1.text: Between the shore of Downtown and the nearest peninsula of to the west of Leaf Links, atop gigatic underwater rocks, one can find a drowned man 'wearing' cement 'shoes'. Another can be found at Washinton Beach. close to where one of the target's of Autocide is cruising on a Tropic. Both men share the same design of a short, overweight man stripped to underwear. easter-egg:2.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:2.text: In Downtown Vice City, near the Vice City News building, there is a window on a building where the player can jump through and find the "Easter Egg Room", which is a brown Easter egg on top of a pedestal.

easter-egg:3.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:3.text: In the window of Funeraria Romero, there is a grave stone which reads "Steven Mulholland R.i.P", a reference to Rockstar North map artist Steven Mulholland. This also features in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.

easter-egg:4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:4.text: A submarine can be seen in the water off the north coast of North Point Mall.

easter-egg:5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:5.text: The tailfins of some airplanes have the Rockstar logo.

easter-egg:6.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:6.text: In Funeraria Romero, there are numerous gravestones and pictures with the Rockstar logo on them.

easter-egg:7.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:7.text: In Little Haiti, there is a sewer system which, on the walls, shows the Rockstar logo several times.

easter-egg:8.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:8.text: Located in Ocean Beach, there is a shop called Rockster Video Games. The name is an obvious reference to Rockstar Games. It also includes artwork of 8-ball and various GTA characters.

easter-egg:9.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:9.text: A pool shaped like the Rockstar Games logo can be seen on Starfish Island.

easter-egg:10.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:10.text: In Tommy Vercetti's room at the Ocean View Hotel, there is a poster featuring Grand Theft Auto III protagonist Claude.

easter-egg:11.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:11.text: The Commodore 64 is referenced in the Rockstar North loading screen. Not only this, but the music in the background is the Grand Theft Auto theme song, Joyride, by Da Shootaz. It is remixed to sound like that of the Commodore 64.

easter-egg:12.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:12.text: Avery Carrington's instructions to Tommy Vercetti during the mission "Two Bit Hit" are almost exactly the same as those given by Donald Love to Claude during the mission "Waka-Gashira Wipeout!" in GTA III. Carrington instructs Love to write down what he is saying to Tommy: "Now, nothing brings down real estate prices quicker than a good old-fashioned gang war - 'cept maybe a disaster, like a biblical plague or someth

easter-egg:13.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:13.text: Dick Tanner, from the mission "Autocide", is a reference to Tanner of the Driver (series) series.

easter-egg:14.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:14.text: Marcus Hammond, Franco Carter and Charlie Dilson, also from the mission "Autocide", are references to Mark Hammond, Frank Carter and Charlie Jolson from The Getaway (video game).

easter-egg:15.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:15.text: Nick Kong is a reference to Nick Kang from True Crime: Streets of L.A..

easter-egg:16.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:16.text: Inside Apartment 3c, a large amount of blood and a chainsaw can be found inside the bathroom, an obvious reference to the famous crime movie Scarface (film).

easter-egg:17.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:17.text: In the film studio, in one of the recording rooms, is a remake of the lunar lander. This is a reference to the conspiracy spuriously alleging that the Lunar landing was filmed on Earth at a soundstage and thus faked, supposedly to upstage the Soviets (with their competing lunar program) or as a convenient distraction from the increasingly unpopular Vietnam War.

easter-egg:18.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:18.text: The Skimmer plane is similar to a seaplane used in the beginning of Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. During the mission "Dildo Dodo", it is mentioned that the seaplane was used in "some old indie movie".

easter-egg:19.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:19.text: Portraits of Frank Sinatra, Bruno Hauptmann and the Mafia are kept at Saint Mark's Bistro, with copies of the real life newspaper Daily News.

easter-egg:20.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:20.text: The Escobar International Airport is named after Pablo Escobar, the real life Tony Montana and probably the biggest drug lord at his time. At the peak of his career, he was smuggling around fifteen tons of cocaine into the United States per day.

easter-egg:21.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:21.text: In the Definitive Edition, a framed newspaper referencing the 1936 trial of Vera Stretz can be seen on the wall behind Sonny Forelli in the opening cutscene inside Marco's Bistro.

easter-egg:22.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:22.text: Alex Shrub may be based on former American president George H. W. Bush and former Florida governor Jeb Bush. A shrub and a bush are both plants, whilst the nickname "Shrub" was given to George W Bush by author Molly Ivins. Shrub's voice is also similar to that of George H. W. Bush.

easter-egg:23.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:23.text: Steve Scott is a parody of Steven Spielberg, as are the films he directs at the InterGlobal Studios lot.

easter-egg:24.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:24.text: The events of "Keep Your Friends Close..." is similar to the ending of Scarface, involving a shootout in the protagonists mansion, although Tommy Vercetti survives the shootout, while Tony Montana is killed.

easter-egg:25.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City
easter-egg:25.text: The mission "Publicity Tour", where Tommy Vercetti drives a limousine whilst Love Fist deactivates a bomb in the back, is based on the film Speed (1994 film) where Officer Jack Traven is forced to drive a bus at over 50 mph to stop a bomb from detonating.
